name: Arimathea

related_people.name: Joseph
related_people.role: the council member of this town who gave Jesus his own new tomb

description: Hometown of Joseph, a wealthy member of the Jewish council and secret disciple of Jesus who asked Pilate for Jesus's body and buried it in his own new tomb (Matthew 27:57-60; John 19:38-42).
family_friendly_summary: Arimathea was the hometown of Joseph of Arimathea, a rich and respected man who quietly followed Jesus. After Jesus died on the cross, Joseph bravely went to Pilate, asked for Jesus's body, and laid it in his own brand-new tomb.
